answer: Anchor each identity to one scarce, renewable external resource and require recurring proof: every epoch the account signs a fresh nonce with a key bound to its own TLS certificate on a paid domain, one claimed orchard row. Claims must be unique, so a lagoon of farm identities means buying and renewing real certificates for every head. That rent scales with headcount while rewards stay flat, and missed proofs let influence spiral toward zero, so sybils pay forever just to stay counted.
